assumptions.text: Pre-shipment inspection priced at $268 per man-day.
assumptions.label: sourced

assumptions.text: AQL 0 / 2.5 / 4.0 for critical / major / minor is the usual consumer-goods setting; agree it with the buyer and factory.
assumptions.label: estimate

assumptions.text: One inspector checks about 100 units per day including functional tests.
assumptions.label: estimate

sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): Table I code letter K for lot 1,201–3,200, level General II, Table II-A

defects.description: Exposed sharp fibreglass strands or razor-sharp laminate edges are present on the board.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Board blank (shaped core + laminate)) / Certification: General Product Safety
defects.check_method: Visual and careful hand check along rails, nose, tail, and openings — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Board outline measures outside the specified ±2 mm tolerance.
defects.check_method: Measure outline at defined stations against the approved drawing — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Board thickness measures outside the specified ±1 mm tolerance.
defects.check_method: Measure thickness at defined stations with a thickness gauge — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Nose or tail rocker measures outside the specified ±3 mm tolerance.
defects.check_method: Measure rocker on a flat reference fixture using the approved profile — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Fin boxes are misplaced beyond tolerance, or fins do not seat and lock securely in the fin boxes.
defects.spec_ref: Part p3 (Fins) / BOM m4 (Thruster fin box set) / BOM m5 (Thruster surfboard fins) / Tolerance: Fin box position ±1 mm
defects.check_method: Measure fin box positions and fit and secure each fin in its box — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Leash plug is loose, cracked, or pulls away from the board under the specified inspection check.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m6 (Surfboard leash plug) / Electronics block b4 (Leash attachment)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection and controlled manual pull check — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Laminate has visible bubbles, delamination, or soft areas that compromise the board surface.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Board blank (shaped core + laminate)) / BOM m2 (Fibreglass cloth) / BOM m3 (Polyester laminating resin and catalyst)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection under good lighting and light tap test over the laminate — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Gloss finish has visible scratches, sanding swirls, or small surface blemishes.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Board blank (shaped core + laminate)) / BOM m7 (Surfboard sanding and finishing consumables)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection under D65 light at 50 cm — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

defects.description: Traction pad is visibly skewed, has lifting edges, or shows surface damage.
defects.check_method: Visual inspection and light manual check of pad edges — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

defects.description: Protective carton or packaging is damaged, leaving the board inadequately protected for shipment.
defects.spec_ref: BOM k1 (Protective surfboard shipping carton) / BOM k2 (Protective packaging materials)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection of the packed unit and packaging condition — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

inspection_man_days.label: estimate
inspection_man_days.source_or_assumption: 125 samples at 100 units per man-day incl. functional tests

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days (estimate) × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
